newsitem.title: FRANCE: FOCUS - Tyremaker Michelin first half profit jumps.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Tyremaker Michelin first half profit jumps.

text.p: French tyremaker Michelin said on Tuesday its first-half profit, excluding taxes and exceptional charges, increased around 50 percent to 2.88 billion francs ($558.8 million).
The company attributed the gain to a small increase in sales despite weakness in the European and North American markets, cuts in production and financial costs, and higher tyre prices.
Net profit fell to 1.35 billion francs in the first half from 1.51 billion after Michelin took a 709 million franc charge to restructure its Spanish subsidiary Neumaticos Michelin.
Stripping out exceptional items, Michelin's first-half profit was up 790 million francs over the prior-year level.
Operating profit rose to 3.62 billion francs from 2.76 billion, boosting the company's first-half operating margin for the second year in a row.
"The two principal factors behind the improvement in the operating margin were on the one hand, the new price levels, and on the other hand, cost controls," Michelin said in a statement.
Tyre prices rose an average two percent in the first half of 1996 over prior-year levels, while its financial costs declined due to lower interest rates.
Production cost reductions accounted for around 40 percent of the improvement in the operating profit, Michelin said.
It said moderate growth this year in its activities and lower costs should contribute to a continuation of the improving trend seen since 1994.

"Overall activity...should be at a satisfying level for the year, with moderate growth compared to the previous year," it said. "The drop in costs will continue to play a favourable part. Michelin thus confirms, for the full year 1996, the improvement it has been achieving since 1994."

Its first-half turnover rose 5.4 percent to 34.91 billion francs as price increases and strong sales growth in Asia and Latin America more than offset weakness in European and North American markets. ($1=5.154 French Franc)
